Description 99.1 Pharming Group reports third quarter 2026 financial results; strong revenue growth, Joenja APDS expansion and CVID topline data in November SIGNATURE Pursuant to the requirements of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, the registrant has duly caused this report to be signed on its behalf by the undersigned, thereunto duly authorized.

By: /s/ Kenneth Lynard Name: Kenneth Lynard Title: Interim Co-CEO & CFO Date: October 27, 2026 2 For investor audiences and media only Pharming Group reports third quarter 2026 financial results; strong revenue growth, Joenja APDS expansion and CVID topline data in November • Third quarter 2026 total revenues increased by 21% to US$117.6 million, compared to third quarter 2025, exceeding market expectations • RUCONEST® revenue increased by 14% to US$93.8 million, compared to third quarter 2025, reflecting demand stabilization and seasonal inventory increase • Joenja® (leniolisib) revenue increased by 58% to US$23.8 million, compared to third quarter 2025, reflecting strong U.S. and international demand • Tightened 2026 total revenue guidance to US$380 million - US$390 million from prior US$375 million - US$395 million • Operating profit increased by 89% to US$29.9 million, compared to third quarter 2025 • Generated US$32.4 million in cash flow from operations in the quarter and US$24.7 million year to date, increasing cash position to US$190.9 million • Strong progress on Joenja expansion including U.S. pediatric label and launches in Germany and Japan • Announced positive Phase II topline data for leniolisib in genetic PIDs with immune dysregulation and Phase II topline data in broader CVID patient population expected in November 2026 • Pharming to host a conference call today at 13:30 CET (8:30 am EDT) Leiden, the Netherlands, October 27, 2026: Pharming Group N.V.

On September 28, 2026, we announced that the FDA had accepted this sNDA and granted the application Priority Review and assigned a Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) target action date of January 30, 2027.

On October 14, 2026, we presented positive topline data from our Phase II trial of leniolisib in genetically identifiable PIDs with immune dysregulation at the 22nd Biennial Meeting of the Europea n Society for Immunodeficiencies (ESID).
Topline results from the pivotal FALCON study are expected approximately one year after the completion of enrollment.

• Top-line data readouts for the two ongoing leniolisib Phase II clinical trials in PIDs with immune dysregulation, including CVID, to expand the asset’s addressable patient population. 7 • Continued progress in enrollment of the pivotal FALCON clinical study for napazimone (KL1333) in mitochondrial DNA-driven primary mitochondrial diseases, with completion of enrollment by the first half of 2027.
